FCC photos show the device using a '''MediaTek''' MT7610U (MT7610UN). :The FCC test report specifies the test program as '''MT76xxU.exe'''. :The Wistron NeWeb part is referenced as DNUR-C4 on the FCC label. It appears to be using an [http://www.rfmd.com/CS/Documents/RFFM4501DS.pdf '''RFMD''' RFFM4501 802.11abgn/ac WLAN FEM] (marked w/ logo, 4501, and KFHU). {{WiFiCert|WFA17763|01/21/2013}} == rt2800usb (partial, as the device is unsupported) chip info dump ==
